text:
Alex (AE): Passing Boreal Health to CS after contract signature. Key points: production target 2025-07-15, expected traffic 8k req/day ramping to 25k by month 3, wants Redwood Private in eu-central-1, strict EU logging/residency, Okta SSO + SCIM, and separate API keys per product team. Renewal window: 9 months. Risk flags: they asked for 13-month log retention and integration with their SIEM (Splunk). Legal cleared but compliance wants SOC2 attestation doc. Please triage infra, SSO, and logging/export needs. CC: @Priya and @Ravi

Priya (CSM): I'll run onboarding. Proposed milestones: 1) Pre-kickoff packet to customer by 2025-04-02 2) SSO smoke test 2025-04-10 to 04-11 3) Pilot API keys + enablement for devs 2025-04-20. Need customer engineering contact and Splunk ingest endpoint details. Also clarifying whether log retention applies to audit logs only or full request payloads.

Ravi (SA): I'll lead the SIEM + logging integration design. Note: exporting request payloads has PII implications; recommend pseudonymization before export. I'll draft an architecture diagram and a streaming export prototype using our log-forwarder. Estimated lift: 4 dev-days plus one config change for the private agent.

Noah (Support Eng): Two support items to flag: 1) SCIM group sync rate limits (we throttle at 600 requests/min per tenant) might need bumping for large orgs. 2) We previously saw Splunk HEC token expiry causing missed events (SUP-7922). I'll open SUP-8930 and attach previous runbook. Please ask customer for sample event schema.

Lina (SRE): Capacity / perf note: To hit <120ms p50 under the projected ramp we'll recommend a dedicated pool with autoscale policy: start 3xA100, scale to 6 under sustained 60% utilization. Enable prefix cache + memkv and q4_0 quant for inference. Also recommend a canary region (eu-west-1) for DR. Provisioning blocked until billing confirms committed tier.

Tess (Billing): Placed in "Pilot" billing tier per AE request. For the extended log retention they will incur storage overage; need to confirm volume and sign-off on addendum. I'll draft the billing addendum and send to Alex by 2025-03-31.

Priya (CSM): Owners & immediate asks: CSM: Priya (kickoff invite), SA: Ravi (architecture + Splunk flow), SE/SSO: Ravi & Noah (SSO tests), Support triage: Noah (SUP-8930), SRE provisioning: Lina, Billing addendum: Tess. Customer contacts: Mateo (Eng lead) mateo@boreal.health and Claire (SecOps) claire@boreal.health.

Alex (AE): Mateo contact confirmed. They want one 90-minute enablement workshop for platform + SIEM integration (up to 12 engineers) and sandbox API keys for two teams. Also requested a quarterly business review cadence.

Noah (Support Eng): Opened SUP-8930 referencing SUP-7922; tagging docs and runbook: https://redwood.app/drive/supp/sup-8930. Please upload sample event schema and SCIM export sample there.

Ravi (SA): Putting initial architecture doc in drive: https://redwood.app/drive/arch/boreal-siem-proposal.md. Will include pseudonymization example and Splunk HEC retry logic snippet. Example snippet:

```
exporter.transform = (event) => {
  event.user_id = hash(event.user_id)
  delete event.payload.sensitive_field
  return event
}
```

Priya (CSM): Action checklist (tracking in CS playbook): 1) Alex to confirm addendum sign-off (by 2025-03-31) 2) Tess to share draft billing addendum (by 2025-03-31) 3) Ravi to deliver arch draft (by 2025-04-03) 4) Noah to run SCIM smoke test (by 2025-04-11) 5) Lina to request dedicated pool provisioning (by 2025-04-05) 6) Priya to schedule enablement (by 2025-04-08). I'll capture attendees and responsibilities in the kickoff doc. :spiral_notepad:

Lina (SRE): I'll provision a staging pool for the SIEM work and drop creds in the playbook. Note: need approval for canary region; if legal requires EU-only we should avoid eu-west-1 for DR until confirmed.

Noah (Support Eng): tagging @infra-oncall for visibility on SUP-8930 escalation path.

infra-oncall: acknowledged. We'll monitor SUP-8930 and engage oncall if it elevates.

Priya (CSM): Thanks team  I'll post the kickoff invite and the shared playbook link here after I finalize. Anyone with blockers DM me. :handshake:
